scenes.label: Blocking
scenes.sub: Blocking calls freeze the event loop, halting all other async tasks.
scenes.say: Blocking calls freeze the event loop, stopping all other async tasks from running.

rows.b: For network or file I O
Runs blocking code outside the loop

scenes.say: To avoid blocking, use async libraries for I O, or offload heavy work to threads or processes with run in executor.
Here, run in executor lets you run a blocking function without freezing your async tasks.

scenes.question: What if you call time.sleep in async code?
scenes.wrong: It runs in parallel, no problem.
scenes.right: It blocks the event loop and halts all async tasks.
scenes.say: If you call a blocking function like time sleep in async code, the event loop stops and nothing else runs. That's a classic interview trap.
